name: spark-one-10-eval-openrouter
cmd: python3 -m spark_one.adapters.run --adapter openrouter --model ${OR_MODEL:-openai/gpt-4o-mini} --bank data/generated/bank --split test --limit 400 --max-usd ${MAX_USD:-3} --out runs/eval-only/openrouter/test_preds.jsonl && python3 -m spark_one.eval.harness --bank data/generated/bank --preds runs/eval-only/openrouter/test_preds.jsonl --out runs/eval-only/openrouter/eval --name "${OR_MODEL:-openai/gpt-4o-mini} (eval only)"
